message.content: I'll take St. James and keep the orange split from turning into someone else's set.
message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to buy or auction the orange property at St. James Place.

St. James Place is unowned while New York and Tennessee are split between other players. Buying it would give me one of three orange properties, but I need $160 to complete the pink group and build houses.

Auctioning would let p4 or p3 acquire a second orange cheaply and strengthen their position. Buying keeps the property out of their hands.

Owning St. James Place would block p4 and p3 from completing the orange group, giving me trade leverage. Virginia remains the priority for the pink monopoly. Even with $316 left after buying, three houses total is manageable, though early house building is more important than a full set.
